snippet.title: Sabado (Full Game Trailer)
snippet.description:
Relive your school memories... but something doesn't want you to leave.

Sabado is a Filipino anime-style p̴̱̾s̸̙̐y̵̗̍c̵̢̓h̸͎̎o̶̲̽l̸̜̄o̷͓͗ḡ̴̘ḭ̵̓c̴̘̈a̸̠͑l̴̥̔ m̷̨̋y̴̥̿s̵tery horror game about revisiting your old high school and reliving the memories you thought were long forgotten.

Or at least...

that's what Jacob thought.

Wishlist now on steam! ⭐
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4986750/Sabado/

Play the Demo! 🎮
https://kiwidreams-01.itch.io/sabado-day-one
